The ''[[Fatality]]'' was a destroyer belonging to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that was carrying dozens of the highly advanced [[HK-51]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]]. Around [[3668 BBY]], when the [[Dread Masters]] were [[Capture of the Dread Masters|captured]] and imprisoned in [[Section X]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], one of their [[Dread Masters' apprentice|apprentices]] stole the ''Fatality'' and tried to rescue them, only to be shot down.
